page.overview:
Who is Lord of the Coast?

The Lord of the Coast is a large Sea King that inhabits the waters around Long Ring Long Land.

The Lord of the Coast is a giant yellow serpentine Sea King, with red spots and fins on its head and sides. It is huge, as all Sea Kings are. It has a lot of sharp, pointed teeth, two small eyes, a big tongue, and flat nostrils.

He is a renowned problem for passing ships and local folk around Long Ring Long Land. Like other Sea Kings such as Lord of the Coast, he is very aggressive and fierce. Most people who encounter him seem to be very afraid of him.

As a Sea King, Lord of the Coast is one of the largest and most powerful creatures to inhabit the ocean. However, he is unable to resist such powerful abilities as the Hie Hie no Mi power.
